S41.name: 皇带鱼
S41.form: an elongated ribbon-like laterally compressed body, a horse-like head, a short blunt snout slightly longer than the eye diameter, medium-sized eyes set high and lateral near the snout, a small terminal mouth slanting upward and lacking teeth on the jaws and palate, naked skin with no scales, many irregular small granular bumps along the flanks
S41.fins: a single long dorsal fin with 400 to 450 rays, the front 10 to 12 rays elongated into filaments
S41.markings: stripes and spots along the body
S41.colour: 体色银亮，具黑色条纹和斑点，且有蓝色条纹

S42.name: 巨口鲨
S42.form: a subcylindrical anterior body, a large wide long blunt head, a very short snout broadly rounded in dorsal view, a huge terminal mouth, a laterally compressed caudal peduncle with no lateral keels
S42.fins: soft fins, large narrow elongated pectoral fins, a broom-shaped tail fin with a long upper lobe only slightly upturned
S42.colour: 前部体色呈棕黑色，腹部偏白色

S43.name: 格陵兰鲨
S43.form: a stout heavy cylindrical body, a short blunt rounded snout, small eyes, a small mouth near the tip of the snout, a short caudal peduncle without a keel
S43.fins: small rounded pectoral fins, two small dorsal fins set far back near the tail, no anal fin, a nearly symmetrical tail fin
S43.colour: 灰褐色至黑褐色，腹部颜色较浅

S44.name: 大王酸浆鱿
S44.form: a large heavy cylindrical mantle, a huge head, very large eyes, eight arms and two long tentacles armed with hooks
S44.fins: a pair of large muscular fins at the rear of the mantle

S45.name: 小头睡鲨
S45.form: a stout heavy cylindrical body, a short blunt rounded snout, small eyes, a small mouth near the tip of the snout, a short caudal peduncle without a keel
S45.fins: small rounded pectoral fins, two small dorsal fins set far back near the tail, no anal fin, a nearly symmetrical tail fin
S45.colour: 灰褐色至黑褐色，腹部颜色较浅

S46.name: 太平洋睡鲨
S46.form: a stout nearly cylindrical body, a short conical blunt snout, the preoral snout length about equal to the mouth width, slender long upper teeth and shorter slanted lower teeth with overlapping bases
S46.fins: two small dorsal fins with no spines, the distance between the dorsal fin bases 45 to 53 percent of the total length, pectoral fins with broad rounded tips, a short asymmetrical tail fin
S46.colour: 鱼鳍成蓝黑色中带不均匀的灰粉红色；通常覆盖着深棕色的黏膜；吻部下侧、上唇和嘴深色具有光泽

S47.name: 尖吻鲭鲨
S47.form: a spindle-shaped body, a pointed snout, long awl-shaped teeth
S47.fins: a triangular dorsal fin, a large crescent-shaped tail fin
S47.colour: 身体上部呈深金属蓝色，腹部呈银白色，侧面有非常明显的颜色分界线

S49.name: 北极霞水母
S49.form: a large bell-shaped body with a bell margin diameter of 30 to 80 cm, many long trailing tentacles
S49.colour: 伞形边缘小于12厘米的小型个体通常是黄色或粉红色；12厘米到45厘米之间的是红色或黄褐色；45厘米以上的呈深棕红色
